buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Technical Eligibility Criteria 1.1. The bidder should have previous experience of successful execution of similar work i.e. Catering, Car etaking, Upkeep and Maintenance Services for period of at least one (1) year, during the last seven ( 7) years ending on the last day of the preceding month in which tender is floated. 1.2. The bidder shall submit the proof of value of reference work (similar work) as per following condition: i) At least one executed similar work having value of the job not less than Rs. 31,57,514.0 0 (Rupees Thirty-One Lakh Fifty-Seven Thousand Five Hundred Fourteen Only) i ncluding applicable tax.

OR ii) At least two executed similar works having value of each job not less than Rs. 25,26,011. 00 (Rupees Twenty-Five Lakh Twenty-Six Thousand and Eleven Only) including a pplicable tax. OR iii) At least three executed similar works having value of each job not less than Rs. 18,94,508 .00 (Rupees Eighteen Lakh Ninety-Four Thousand Five Hundred and Eight Only) i ncluding applicable tax. 1.3. Documentary evidences to be submitted to meet the technical PQ i) As a proof of work order: Notarized copies of work orders / Purchase orders issued by the Cli ent. ii) As a proof of Completion/execution: a. Notarized copies of Invoice copies along with the corresponding payment advises for the submitted relevant work orders. (or) b. Notarized copies of Completion certificate/Execution certificate from client for successful exe cution of submitted relevant work orders. 2. Financial Eligibility Criteria The average annual financial turnover of the Bidder during the last three (3) consecutive financial y st ears ending 31 March’ 2026 shall not be less than Rs. 25,26,011/- a) In order to substantiate the above turnover requirement, the Bidder shall submit signed copies of the Audited Annual Financial Reports, including the Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss St atement, for the last three (3) consecutive financial years ending 31st March 2026. The signed B alance Sheet and Profit & Loss Statement furnished by the Bidder for establishing financial eligibil ity shall clearly indicate the Membership Number and Firm Registration Number (FRN) of the Char tered Accountant, along with the UDIN, in accordance with the guidelines of the ICAI. b) In case of non-availability of Audited Annual Financial Reports for genuine reasons, as an alterna te, with reasoned proof, the bidder may submit certified annual Turnover from a practicing-chart ered accountant, duly notarised, in support of their financial credentials, in lieu of annual reports to substantiate the financial eligibility. The Chartered Accountant’s Certificate should clearly indic ate the Membership Number and Firm Registration Number (FRN) of the Chartered Accountant, al ong with the UDIN. c) In case of Companies / Firms which are less than three (3) years old, the average annual turnov er of the bidder shall be calculated by considering the turnover as per the audited balance sheet and Profit & Loss statement or Charted Accountant’s certificate (for bidder(s) as per Sl. No. (b) ab ove) submitted by the bidder for available period divided by three (3). d) In case of Companies / Firms which are more than three (3) years old, bidders are mandatorily re quired to submit the Audited Annual Financial Reports, including the balance sheet and Profit & L oss statement or Chartered Accountant’s Certificate (for bidder(s) as per Sl. No. (b) above) for all the three (3) consecutive financial years, failing which their bid will be liable for rejection. e) Annual financial turnover of entities participating in the tender on their own strength only shall b e considered and not that of their related entities, such as holding companies, subsidiaries or gro up companies, etc. The Bidder shall be an independent legal entity and shall have its own indepe ndent financial accounting system, as per laws of the land.

Note: 1. Relaxation of 15% in financial eligibility criteria with respect to prior turnover for MSEs and 2 0% in the case of SC/ ST and woman-owned MSEs shall be applicable. 2. Relaxation of 20% in financial eligibility criteria with respect to prior turnover for Start-ups sh all be applicable. For Start-up Companies, the bidder shall submit a valid DPIIT Certificate of Recognition. 3. In case a bidder is both a Start-up Company and an MSE, only the relaxation applicable to St art-ups, as specified in Clause 2 above, shall apply. No additional relaxation in the financial elig ibility criteria applicable to MSEs, as specified in Clause 1 above, shall be admissible. 3. Consortium bids/JV shall not be permitted. 4. BIDDER SHALL STRICTLY ENSURE THAT TECHNICAL BID DOES NOT CONTAIN ANY PRICE AT ALL, AS PRICE ARE TO BE QUOTED IN FINANCIAL BID ONLY. IF THE BIDDER SUBMITS THE PRICE OTHER THAN IN FINANCIAL BID, IT SHALL BE TREATED AS PRICE RECEIVED IN OPEN CONDITION, AND THEIR OFFER IS LIABLE FOR REJE CTION. . 3.
